test.evangelist.1: Hello, friend! Why do you look so sad?
test.christian.1: This burden is so heavy. I don't know where to go.
test.evangelist.2: Do you see that little light, far away? Walk to it, and you will find a gate.
test.evangelist.3: Will you go, even with that big sack?
test.choice.brave: Yes! I will go right now!
test.choice.funny: Only if the sack walks too!
test.evangelist.4: Good! Keep your eyes on the light.
test.evangelist.5: Ha ha! Sacks are lazy, but you can walk!
cutscene.sample.1: Look over there, far away. Can you see the light?

ui.satchel.gift.breastplate.line: Keeps your heart safe in a fight.
ui.satchel.gift.shoes.line: No more slipping on wet rocks.

promise.p01.text: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
promise.p02.text: Fear not: for I am with thee...
promise.p03.text: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
promise.p04.text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
promise.p05.text: ...This is the way, walk ye in it...
promise.p06.text: ...knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
promise.p07.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
promise.p08.text: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
promise.p09.text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
promise.p10.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
promise.p11.text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
promise.p12.text: ...they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
promise.p13.text: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
promise.p14.text: ...be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
promise.p15.text: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
promise.p16.text: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
promise.p17.text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
promise.p18.text: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
promise.p19.text: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
promise.p21.text: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
promise.p22.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
promise.p23.text: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee...
promise.p24.text: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes...
friend.christian.name: Christian
friend.christian.line: That's you! A pilgrim on the way to the shining City.
friend.christiana.name: Christiana
friend.christiana.line: Christian's wife. She loves her four boys very much.
friend.sons.name: The four boys
friend.sons.line: Christian's sons. Small, noisy and full of questions.
friend.evangelist.name: Evangelist
friend.evangelist.line: Brings good news and always points the way.
friend.obstinate.name: Obstinate
friend.obstinate.line: Never changes his mind. Not even a tiny bit.
friend.pliable.name: Pliable
friend.pliable.line: Says yes to everything, gives up fast.
friend.help.name: Help
friend.help.line: A big, kind man who pulls pilgrims out of the mud.
friend.wiseman.name: Mr. Worldly Wiseman
friend.wiseman.line: Very fancy and very sure. Very wrong about the road.
friend.goodwill.name: Goodwill
friend.goodwill.line: Keeps the little gate. He is glad to let you in.
friend.interpreter.name: The Interpreter
friend.interpreter.line: Shows you pictures that explain big ideas.
friend.shining_ones.name: The Shining Ones
friend.shining_ones.line: Tall, bright and kind. They bring good gifts from the King.
friend.simple.name: Simple
friend.simple.line: Snores in chains and says there's nothing to worry about.
friend.sloth.name: Sloth
friend.sloth.line: Wants five more minutes of sleep. Then five more.
friend.presumption.name: Presumption
friend.presumption.line: Says he's fine on his own. He isn't.
friend.formalist.name: Formalist
friend.formalist.line: Climbed over the wall instead of using the gate.
friend.hypocrisy.name: Hypocrisy
friend.hypocrisy.line: Looks good on the outside. Only on the outside.
friend.timorous.name: Timorous
friend.mistrust.name: Mistrust
friend.mistrust.line: Ran back down the hill. He doesn't trust anyone.
friend.watchful.name: Watchful
friend.watchful.line: The porter with the lantern. He says: keep to the middle!
friend.discretion.name: Discretion
friend.discretion.line: Thinks before she speaks. She keeps a book close.
friend.prudence.name: Prudence
friend.prudence.line: Careful and wise. She weighs things on her scales.
friend.piety.name: Piety
friend.piety.line: Loves to talk about the King. She carries a flower.
friend.charity.name: Charity
friend.charity.line: Kind to everyone. She always shares her bread.
friend.faithful.name: Faithful
friend.faithful.line: A true friend. He never stops trusting the King.
friend.talkative.name: Talkative
friend.talkative.line: Talks and talks and talks. But never does anything.
friend.hate_good.name: Lord Hate-good
friend.hate_good.line: A grumpy judge in a giant wig. He doesn't like good things.
friend.envy.name: Envy
friend.envy.line: Always wants what someone else has.
friend.superstition.name: Superstition
friend.superstition.line: Trusts lucky charms more than the truth.
friend.pickthank.name: Pickthank
friend.pickthank.line: Says nice things just to get a pat on the head.
friend.hopeful.name: Hopeful
friend.hopeful.line: Your new friend from the fair. Bright eyes, big hope.
friend.byends.name: Mr. By-ends
friend.byends.line: Walks with you only when the road is sunny and easy.
friend.hold_the_world.name: Mr. Hold-the-world
friend.hold_the_world.line: Holds on tight to his money. Very tight.
friend.money_love.name: Mr. Money-love
friend.money_love.line: Loves money more than anything else.
friend.save_all.name: Mr. Save-all
friend.demas.name: Demas
friend.demas.line: Waves at you from a shiny silver pit. Don't go over!
friend.vain_confidence.name: Vain-confidence
friend.vain_confidence.line: So sure of himself, he forgets to look where he walks.
friend.giant_despair.name: Giant Despair
friend.giant_despair.line: Big, grumpy and very slow. Sunshine makes him freeze!
friend.diffidence.name: Diffidence
friend.diffidence.line: The giant's bossy wife. She whispers bad ideas.
friend.knowledge.name: Knowledge
friend.knowledge.line: A shepherd who knows these mountains very well.
friend.experience.name: Experience
friend.experience.line: A shepherd who has seen it all before.
friend.shepherd_watchful.name: Watchful the shepherd
friend.shepherd_watchful.line: A shepherd who keeps an eye on every sheep.
friend.sincere.name: Sincere
friend.sincere.line: A shepherd who always means what he says.
friend.ignorance.name: Ignorance
friend.ignorance.line: Cheerful and skipping. He came by his own crooked lane.
friend.flatterer.name: The Flatterer
friend.flatterer.line: Smiles a lot and says nice things to lead you off the Way.
friend.atheist.name: Atheist
friend.atheist.line: Laughs at the City and walks back the other way.
friend.secret.name: Secret
friend.secret.line: Brings Christiana a letter from the King.
ui.dialogueTest.title: A TALK ON THE WAY
bark.generic.lowHope.1: You look tired, but I am right here.
bark.generic.lowHope.2: It is okay to feel sad today.
bark.generic.lowHope.4: The light is still there, even when you cannot feel it.
bark.generic.lowHope.5: I will not leave you. Not one step.
bark.generic.cheer.1: Look up, the light is still ahead!
bark.generic.cheer.2: One more step, you can do it!
bark.generic.cheer.4: You are braver than you know!
bark.generic.cheer.5: We are almost there, keep going!
bark.generic.promise.1: Look, something is glowing over there!
bark.generic.promise.2: I see a shiny scroll nearby!
bark.generic.promise.3: A Promise is close, let's find it!
bark.generic.promise.4: Do you see that glow? Go closer!
bark.generic.promise.5: Something wonderful is hidden just off the path!
bark.generic.promiseFound.1: You found it! A Promise from the King!
bark.generic.promiseFound.2: A Promise! Read it later and it will give you hope!
bark.generic.promiseFound.3: Yes! Keep it safe in your satchel!
bark.generic.detour.1: Hmm, this does not look like the Way.
bark.generic.detour.2: Are you sure about this path?
bark.generic.detour.3: I think the Way is back there.
bark.generic.idle.2: The road is waiting for us.
bark.generic.idle.3: I am ready when you are!
bark.generic.idle.4: The light ahead looks a little brighter today.
bark.generic.idle.5: I wonder what is around the next corner?
ch01.objective.readBook: Read the Book on the table
ch01.objective.goHome: Go back home for the evening
ch01.objective.toGate: Go out through the town gate
ch01.toast.neighbours: Nobody listens. Maybe go home for the evening.
ch01.toast.note: A note from Evangelist is in your satchel.
ui.satchel.item.note.name: Evangelist's note
ui.satchel.item.note.line: It says: Flee from the wrath to come.
ch01.book.1: The Book says our city will not last. It will fall, like a sandcastle when the tide comes in.
ch01.book.2: Flee to the far light, it says. There is a gate, and a Way, and a King who waits.
ch01.book.3: Oh dear. My pack feels heavier already.
ch01.day.1: Christian, you look so pale! Did that old Book scare you again?
ch01.day.2: It says our city will not last. We must all leave, and soon.
ch01.day.3: Leave? But my marbles are here!
ch01.day.5: Hush, boys. Go for a walk, dear, and clear your head.
ch01.day.6: Then we will talk about it tonight. Off you go.
ch01.day.c2: But what if the Book is right?
ch01.eve.1: There you are. The soup is nearly cold!
ch01.eve.2: Nobody in town believes me. They only shrug and laugh.
ch01.eve.3: I believe you, Papa. A bit.
ch01.eve.4: I believe you a LOT. Can I come?
ch01.eve.5: Sleep on it, love. Things look better in the morning.
ch01.eve.6: No. I have to see what is out there.
ch01.eve.c1: I cannot sleep. I must go to the gate.
ch01.ev.1: Good evening, friend. Why do you sigh so loudly?
ch01.ev.2: My Book says this city will fall. But I do not know where to go.
ch01.ev.3: Look far away. Do you see that tiny light?
ch01.ev.c2: I think so. Is it a star?
ch01.ev.c3: I only see my big heavy sack.
ch01.ev.4b: Not a star. A gate, with a Way that leads to it.
ch01.ev.4c: Ha! Then walk toward the light, and the sack will see it too.
ch01.ev.5: Keep that light in your eyes. Here, a note for the road.
ch01.ev.6: It says: Flee from the wrath to come. Go now, and do not stop.
ch01.ev.7: The light. I will follow the light.
ch01.call.6: I cannot look back. Light, light, light!
ch01.chase.1: Stop right there, neighbour! Where do you think you are going?
ch01.chase.2: To the far light. The Book says our city will fall.
ch01.chase.3: Books, bah! Come home and stop being silly.
ch01.chase.4: Wait, wait! Is it true there are golden streets there?
ch01.chase.c3: Golden streets and crowns, they say.
ch01.chase.6: Crowns, pah! I am going home to my dinner.
ch01.chase.7: Well, I am coming! Walk faster, I want a crown by supper.
ch01.end.1: Are we nearly there? Do the streets really shine?
ch01.end.2: The Book says they do. But first the road goes on a long way.
ch01.end.3: Then let's hurry! Golden streets, here we come!
ch01.crowd.shrug.1: Leaving? Pfft, the city is fine.
ch01.crowd.laugh.1: Ha ha ha, a sack AND a Book? Hic!
ch01.crowd.laugh.2: Oh no, now I have the hiccups! Hic, hic!
ch01.crowd.silly.1: Mind the pumpkin! It is bigger than my head.
ch01.bark.pliable.fields: Ooh, is that the light? Does it come with a crown?
ch01.bark.pliable.idle.1: Come on! Golden streets will not walk to us.
ch01.bark.pliable.idle.2: Are we resting? I was not tired yet.
ch01.bark.pliable.cheer.1: Cheer up! Think of all the shiny things.
ch01.bark.pliable.cheer.2: Keep going! Crowns do not come to quitters.
ch02.pliable.start.1: Golden streets, Christian! Crowns for everyone!
ch02.christian.start.1: That is what the Book says. A kingdom that never ends.
ch02.pliable.start.2: Then walk faster! I want my crown before teatime.
ch02.christian.start.2: This sack is heavy, Pliable. But I am coming.
ch02.bark.pliable.chat.1: Golden streets! Do they polish them every day?
ch02.bark.pliable.chat.2: Race you to the crowns! Well, maybe not with that sack.
ch02.bark.pliable.idle.2: Do you think I get a crown too?
ch02.bark.pliable.idle.3: Come on, the gold will not wait!
ch02.bark.pliable.promise.1: Ooh, is that treasure? Grab it!
ch02.bark.pliable.low.1: Cheer up, Christian. Think of the gold!
ch02.bark.pliable.boot.1: My boot! Give it back, you greedy mud!
ch02.pliable.sink.1: Ugh! Christian, the ground is eating my feet!
ch02.christian.sink.1: It is a bog. Stand still, it gets worse when you run!
ch02.pliable.sink.2: I cannot stand still! My legs will not listen!
ch02.pliable.sink.3: SLURP! The mud swallowed my boot, Christian!
ch02.pliable.quits.1: That is it! No more mud for me.
ch02.pliable.quits.2: If the Way starts like this, what comes next? I am going home.
ch02.choice.stay: Please stay. We can find a way across together.
ch02.choice.go: Go home then. I am still going on.
ch02.pliable.quits.stay: I see only mud, Christian. Keep your crown, I want dry socks!
ch02.pliable.quits.go: Fine! Do not come crying to me when you sink.
ch02.christian.quits.2: Goodbye, Pliable. I hope you find your boot.
ch02.help.call.1: Over here, friend! Give me your hand!
ch02.help.1: Up you come! There, that is better.
ch02.help.2: Tell me, friend. Why did you not look for the steps?
ch02.christian.help.1: Steps? I saw only mud, and I was scared.
ch02.help.3: The King laid good steps right through the middle. Stand still and look, and they shine.
ch02.christian.help.2: Thank you, Help! I will remember that.
ch02.help.again.1: The Gate is not far now. Keep to the steps and keep going!
ch02.christian.end.1: The bog is behind me. The Gate must be close now!
ch03.wiseman.1: Good day, good day! What a heavy sack for such a small road.
ch03.christian.1: I am going to the little gate. Evangelist showed me the way.
ch03.wiseman.2: That bumpy old road? Oh no, no, I know a far better one.
ch03.christian.hat: Sir! Your hat just blew away!
ch03.wiseman.3: Nothing happened to my hat. Now, go and see Mr. Legality in the village of Morality.
ch03.choice.polite: Thank you, sir. You are very kind.
ch03.choice.doubt: But Evangelist said the gate is the way...
ch03.choice.funny: Does Mr. Legality mend hats too?
ch03.wiseman.polite: Kind? Of course I am, to people who listen to me.
ch03.wiseman.doubt: Evangelist means well, but he does love a long bumpy walk.
ch03.wiseman.funny: Hats are not the point! Although, yes, he probably does.
ch03.wiseman.4: Take the smooth sunny road, right there. Past the pretty village, under that friendly mountain.
ch03.christian.darker: It is getting dark. And this sack feels heavier.
ch03.christian.door: The village never gets any closer!
ch03.evangelist.1: Christian! What are you doing so far from the Way?
ch03.christian.3: A fine gentleman sent me to the village. He said Mr. Legality would take my burden off.
ch03.evangelist.2: Look up at that mountain. It leans over the whole road, and one day it will fall.
ch03.evangelist.3: Nobody in that village can lift your burden. Only the gate leads to the place where it comes off.
ch03.choice.sorry: I am sorry. I wanted an easier road.
ch03.evangelist.sorry: Everyone wants an easier road. Come, the Way is waiting for you.
ch03.evangelist.confused: People who sound sure are not always right. Come, I will walk you back.
ch03.evangelist.4: Follow me and keep close. Leave the mountain to grumble by itself.
ch03.evangelist.back: There, the Way again! Feel your Hope come back.
ch03.evangelist.bye: Straight on now, my friend. The gate is not far.
ch03.christian.end: No more smooth roads for me. The narrow Way it is!
ch03.christian.talkFirst: That fancy gentleman looks like he wants a word.
ch03.christian.notYet: Wait. Mr. Wiseman said the village is that way...
ch04.toast.hideRocks: Arrows! Hide behind the rocks between volleys.
ch04.goodwill.say.comeIn: Knock knock? Quick, in you come!
ch04.goodwill.2: I am Goodwill, and I keep this little gate. It opens for everyone who knocks.
ch04.christian.1: Thank you! Those arrows nearly got me.
ch04.goodwill.3: They always miss the ones who keep walking. Tell me, who sent you here?
ch04.choice.evangelist: Evangelist pointed me to the light.
ch04.choice.city: I ran from a city that is in danger.
ch04.choice.sack: My sack sent me. It wanted a holiday.
ch04.goodwill.4a: Evangelist! He sends me the best pilgrims.
ch04.goodwill.4b: Then you ran the right way. Nobody who comes in here is sent back.
ch04.goodwill.4c: Ha! Tell your sack it must wait a little longer.
ch04.goodwill.5: Now, see that straight road? Keep to it and never turn off.
ch04.goodwill.6: It leads to the Interpreter's House. Knock there too.
ch04.christian.2: Straight on. I can do that!

ch05.toast.room1: A true guide looks up and points the way.
ch05.toast.room2: Trying harder will not clean a heart. Grace does.
ch05.toast.room4: Help you cannot see keeps you going.
ch05.toast.room6: Despair is a cage. Remember this place.
ch05.toast.allRooms: You have seen all six rooms.
ch05.interpreter.1: Come in, little pilgrim. I have things to show you.
ch05.interpreter.2: Look carefully. Each room holds a lesson for the road ahead.
ch06.objective.climbHill: Climb the hill to the Cross
ch06.toast.keyPromise: A key has been placed in your satchel.
ch06.toast.shiningOnes: Three Shining Ones come to you.
ch06.toast.sleepers: Simple, Sloth and Presumption are still asleep.
ch06.shining.clothes: Here are new clothes, white as light.
ch06.shining.roll: Take this Roll. It will be your ticket to the City.
ch07.toast.spring: You drink from the spring. Hope is refreshed! +15
ch07.toast.arbour: Christian sits and naps... the Roll slips away.
ch07.toast.rollLost: Oh no, the Roll is gone!
ch07.toast.lions: Keep to the middle of the path!
ch07.toast.armoury: The armoury! New gifts for the road.
ch07.watchful.middle: Stay to the middle of the path! The lions are chained!
ch07.watchful.welcome: Welcome, pilgrim. You are safe here.
ch07.discretion.1: Come in from the night. Rest now.
ch07.charity.1: Do you think of your family?
ch07.christian.family: I do. I hope they will follow.
ch08.toast.apollyonApproaches: A great shadow falls over the valley...
ch08.toast.phase1: Block his paw with the Shield, then strike his belly!
ch08.toast.phase2: Deflect the darts with a Perfect Block!
ch08.toast.phase3: Apollyon throws you down. Reach for the sword!
ch08.toast.victory: Apollyon flaps away! Healing leaves fall from above.
ch08.apollyon.claim: This whole country is mine, little Christian. You belong to me.
ch08.choice.brave: I belong to the King of the Celestial City!
ch08.choice.polite: No, sir. I have left your service for good.
ch08.choice.funny: I think you have the wrong pilgrim!
ch09.objective.crossValley: Cross the Valley of the Shadow
ch09.objective.prayPath: Pray to clear the smoking pit
ch09.whisper.tooSmall: You are too small for this...
ch09.toast.dark: It is very dark. The lantern is your only light.
ch09.toast.smokingPit: A smoking pit blocks the path. You must pray.
ch09.toast.pitCleared: The smoke parts! You can pass.
ch09.toast.voiceAhead: A voice ahead: "Though I walk through the valley of the shadow, I will fear no evil."
ch09.toast.dawn: Dawn breaks. The traps are now easy to see.
ch09.twoMen.warning1: Go back! There are horrible things ahead!
ch09.twoMen.warning2: No pilgrim has ever passed through!
ch10.objective.escapeNight: Sneak through the fair at night
ch10.toast.talkativeLeaves: Talkative wanders off. He only ever talked.
ch10.toast.enterFair: Vanity! Everything here is for sale — except the truth.
ch10.toast.arrested: You are thrown into a cage in the square.
ch10.toast.faithfulDeparts: A chariot of light comes for Faithful. He went to the King first.
ch10.toast.sneakingNight: The fair is empty. Sneak to the gate!
ch10.faithful.join2: I heard what happened to you. I want to go to the City too.
ch10.christian.faithful: Come, then. Let us walk together.
ch10.talkative.1: I love to talk about holy things. There is nothing I do not know.
ch10.talkative.2: Ask me anything! I have read all the books.
ch10.choice.ask1: Does knowing help you do what is right?
ch10.choice.ask2: Are you ever sorry for the wrong you do?
ch10.talkative.sniff: That is a very personal question. I think I shall walk alone.
ch10.evangelist.warn1: Listen to me. The town ahead will test you both.
ch10.evangelist.warn2: One of you will go to the King before the other.
ch10.hopeful.join1: I saw what happened to Faithful. I want to follow the same road.
bark.ch10.faithful.idle.1: The road goes on a long way yet.
bark.ch10.faithful.idle.2: I am glad we walk together.
bark.ch10.faithful.cheer.1: Do not give up! We are nearly through.
bark.ch10.hopeful.idle.1: I never thought I would be on this road.
bark.ch10.hopeful.idle.2: Do you think we are halfway there?
bark.ch10.hopeful.cheer.1: I feel the bottom, and it is good!
bark.ch10.hopeful.cheer.2: You can do this. I am right here.
bark.ch10.hopeful.lowHope.1: Do not be afraid. The King has not forgotten us.
ch11.objective.findWayOut: Find a way out of the dungeon
ch11.toast.mineBonk: The edge crumbles! Back on the Way.
ch11.toast.pillarSalt: Remember Lot's wife. A warning from long ago.
ch11.toast.riverRest: You rest by the river. Hope is fully restored!
ch11.toast.storm: A great storm rises! You cannot go back.
ch11.toast.dungeon: Giant Despair throws you in the dungeon.
ch11.toast.needKey: Hmm. Is there something in your satchel that might help?
ch11.toast.lockOpen: Click! The cell door swings open.
ch11.toast.giantFreezes: Morning sunshine! The giant freezes mid-stomp.
ch11.toast.warningSign: You put up a warning sign for other pilgrims.
ch11.byEnds.1: I too am going to the Celestial City! We agree on everything.
ch11.byEnds.2: Good weather or bad, I go when it suits me best.
ch11.demas.1: Come and see the silver mine! Just a quick look.
ch11.demas.2: There is treasure here. The King will never know.
ch11.hopeful.encourage1: Christian, did the King give you something at the Cross?
ch11.hopeful.encourage2: Look in your satchel. There might be a key.
ch11.keyHint.1: I feel sure there is something we are forgetting.
ch12.objective.lookGlass: Find the viewpoint with the Looking Glass
ch12.objective.stayAwake: Talk with Hopeful to stay awake!
ch12.toast.shepherdWarning: Beware the Flatterer, and do not sleep on the Enchanted Ground!
ch12.toast.lookingGlass: For two seconds you see the Celestial Gate! It is real.
ch12.toast.correctPath: You saw through the Flatterer! Sharp eyes!
ch12.toast.flattererNet: A net drops over you! A Shining One comes to set you free.
ch12.toast.shiningOneFrees: You are free. Remember the shepherd's warning.
ch12.toast.atheistLaughs: An Atheist laughs and walks back the other way.
ch12.toast.enchantedGround: The air is heavy and sweet. Do not sit down. Talk to Hopeful!
ch12.knowledge.1: Welcome, pilgrims! We are the shepherds of these mountains.
ch12.experience.1: Many have passed here before you. You are almost there.
ch12.watchful_s.1: Keep watching! The way is clear from here.
ch12.sincere.1: Be honest with yourself and the road will be honest with you.
ch12.ignorance.1: I am fine! I shall get into the City my own way.
ch12.ignorance.2: I do not need a roll. My heart is good.
ch12.hopeful_talk.1: Tell me, Hopeful — how did you first trust the King?
ch12.hopeful_talk.2: I saw Faithful in the fair. He was not afraid.
ch12.hopeful_talk.3: And I thought: I want to know that King too.
ch12.hopeful_talk.4: That is when I stepped onto this road.
ch13.objective.prayRiver: Hold [Q] Pray to keep your courage up
ch13.objective.showRoll: Show the Roll at the Gate
ch13.toast.beulah: Beulah: flowers, birdsong and warm light. The City is close.
ch13.toast.riverDepth: The river is deeper or shallower depending on how much you trust the King.
ch13.toast.prayToStayUp: The water is rising. Hold [Q] Pray to keep your hope up!
ch13.toast.armourLight: Your armour and clothes turn to light.
ch13.toast.gateOpens: The gate opens! Bells ring. Light fills everything.
ch13.shining.1: The river will carry you safely. Trust the King.
ch13.shining.2: The depth depends on your faith.
ch13.hopeful.bottom: I feel the bottom, and it is good!
ch13.gate.1: Show your Roll. Is your name written there?
epilogue.toast.invitation: An invitation — from the King himself.
epilogue.christiana.1: Christian... why did I not go with you?
epilogue.christiana.2: I should have listened. The boys ask for their father every day.
epilogue.secret.1: Christiana, the King of the Celestial City has not forgotten you.
epilogue.secret.2: He sends you this letter. He invites you to come.
epilogue.christiana.reads: He... he wants me to come too.
epilogue.secret.reply: He wants all of you. You and your four sons.
ch05.interpreter.enter: Come in, little pilgrim. I have six rooms to show you.
ch05.interpreter.welcome: Each room holds a lesson for the road ahead.
ch05.interpreter.room1: A true guide looks up and points the way. Remember this face.
ch05.interpreter.room2: Sweeping stirs up dust. Only water settles it.
ch05.interpreter.room3: Passion gets his toys now. Patience waits for something better.
ch05.interpreter.room4: Someone throws water, yet the fire grows. Walk round and see why.
ch05.interpreter.room5: The scribe writes the name of any who dare to go in. Will you give your name?
ch05.interpreter.room6: This man chose despair. Remember this when your heart grows dark.
ch06.shining.newClothes: New clothes, white as morning light. And a mark on your forehead.
ch07.timorous.warning: Go back! There are two lions on the path!
ch07.discretion.welcome: Pilgrim, you are welcome here. Come in and rest.
ch07.prudence.gift: Tell me — what do you think of the life you have left behind?
ch07.piety.gift: Do you love the One who called you to this road?
ch07.charity.gift: You left your family. Does that grieve you?
ch07.christian.grateful: Yes. But I trust the King cares for them.
ch07.christian.thanks: Thank you all. I am ready for whatever is ahead.
ch08.apollyon.fight: Then I will break you here!
ch08.apollyon.flee: Hmph! This is not over, little pilgrim!
ch08.christian.no1: I belong to the King of the Celestial City. I will not return to you.
ch09.men.warning: Go back! The valley ahead is full of terrors.
ch09.men.warning2: Not one pilgrim has ever walked through and come back to tell us!
ch09.christian.psalm: Though I walk through the valley of the shadow... I will fear no evil.
ch10.talkative.3: I know all the right words. Is that not the same thing?
ch10.talkative.leaves: Hmph! Some people are no fun at all.
ch10.evangelist.warn: One of you will reach the King before the other. Whichever it is, do not be afraid.
ch10.christian.question: Do you do the things you talk about?
ch10.hopeful.join: I saw Faithful. May I walk with you to the City?
ch11.byends.1: Hello! We are going to the same City, you and I.
ch11.byends.2: I find it best to follow the King when the weather suits me.
ch11.christian.no: We follow the King whether it is easy or hard. That is not the same road.
ch11.hopeful.1: I know it is hard. But I feel sure there is a way out.
ch11.hopeful.2: The King has not forgotten us. I know it.
ch11.hopeful.key_hint: Did the King give you something at the Cross? Check your satchel.
ch12.knowledge.welcome: Welcome to the Delectable Mountains, pilgrims! We are the shepherds here.
ch12.knowledge.warn: Beware the Flatterer in white. He points at you, not the Way.
ch12.experience.seen: Many pilgrims have passed this way. You are closer than you think.
ch12.watchful.warn: Do not sleep on the Enchanted Ground. Keep talking.
ch12.sincere.gift: Be honest with yourselves and the King. That is the best gift we can give you.
ch12.ignorance.fine: I am doing very well, thank you. My heart is good and I shall get in just fine.
ch12.christian.roll: You will need a Roll to show at the Gate. Do you have one?
ch12.hopeful.trust1: I will tell you. It was at Vanity Fair, watching Faithful.
ch12.hopeful.trust2: He was not afraid. And I thought: what does he know that I do not?
ch12.hopeful.trust3: I could not get the question out of my head. So I started asking it properly.
ch12.hopeful.trust4: And the King answered. That is when I stepped onto this road.
ch13.shining.depth: The river is deeper or shallower depending on how much you trust the King.
ch13.shining.courage: Do not be afraid. He is with you in the water.
epilogue.christiana.misses: Christian... I should have gone with you. I was afraid.
epilogue.christiana.sorry: And now the boys cry for their father every night. I am so sorry.
epilogue.secret.letter: Christiana, the King of the Celestial City has not forgotten you. He invites you and your sons to come.
epilogue.christiana.smile: He... he wants us to come. All of us.
ch06.toast.narrowWay: The road is narrow here. Keep climbing!
ch06.toast.freeAtLast: Free at last! Run and jump!
ch06.toast.notYet: The Cross is up the hill. Go there first.
ch06.christian.wake: Wake up! There is danger here!
ch06.simple.reply: Danger? I see no danger... Zzz.
ch06.sloth.reply: Five more minutes, maybe ten... Zzz.
ch06.presumption.reply: I can look after myself, thank you. Zzz...
ch06.christian.sigh: They will not wake up. I must go on.
ch06.formalist.hop: Hup, over the wall! Much quicker than that silly gate.
ch06.christian.gate: But the King said to come in by the gate.
ch06.hypocrisy.fine: We are on the road now, are we not? Same thing!
ch07.toast.springHere: A cool spring at the foot of the hill.
ch07.toast.refreshed: Fresh, cool water! You feel ready to climb.
ch07.toast.detourWarning: Two easy paths go round the hill. The Way goes up.
ch07.toast.restBench: What a comfy bench... just a little rest...
ch07.toast.keepMiddle: Keep to the middle of the path!
ch07.toast.seeTheCity: Far away, blue mountains shine in the morning sun.
ch07.objective.keepMiddle: Keep to the middle of the path
ch07.christian.lions: Lions, but they are chained. I will keep to the middle.
ch07.mistrust.run: Run! The lions will gobble us up!
ch07.christian.onward: I am scared too. But the Way goes up, so I go up.
ch07.watchful.armoury: Come and see the armoury. The King has gifts for you.
ch07.discretion.armour: A sword, a shield, a helmet and more. Wear them well.
ch07.discretion.farewell: Go on in peace, pilgrim. We will walk you down the hill.
ch07.christian.bye: Thank you all. I will remember this house.
ch08.toast.paws: Apollyon slams his huge paws! Christian holds up his shield.
ch08.toast.strike: His belly glows. Christian strikes with his sword!
ch08.toast.darts: Apollyon flies up and throws fiery darts!
ch08.toast.bounce: Clang! The shield bounces the darts right back!
ch08.toast.mustFight: Apollyon blocks the way. You cannot go round him.
ch08.discretion.down: This is as far as we may come. The King goes with you.
ch08.prudence.down: Keep your shield up, and remember your Promises.
ch08.christian.goodbye: Goodbye, dear friends. I will be brave.
ch08.christian.arise: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise.
ch08.christian.phew: Phew, the King helped me! My hearts feel strong again.
ch09.christian.notAlone: Someone else is on the road! I am not alone.
ch09.toast.traps: Snares and pits! Now you can see them. Step around.
ch09.christian.dawn: The sun is up! The dark could not keep me.
ch09.christian.end: I made it through. Now, who was that voice ahead?
ch11.toast.lastLock: The outer door opens! Only the iron gate is left.
ch11.toast.gateStiff: The key turns, but the gate is stiff. Push!
ch11.toast.useKey: Open your satchel and use the Key.
ch11.christian.remember: Wait, at the Cross they put something in my satchel. A key called Promise!
ch11.christian.cageOpen: The man in the Interpreter's cage could not get out. But this door opened!
ch11.hopeful.cheer: The King's Promise opens every lock. Come on!
ch12.flatterer.hello: What clever, handsome pilgrims you are! Follow me, I know a much nicer way.
ch12.hopeful.unsure: He only points at us. The Portrait guide pointed up to the Way.
ch05.toast.seeAllRooms: The Interpreter has more to show you first.
ch05.interpreter.farewell: Remember what you saw here. Each room will help you on the road.
ch05.christian.farewell: I will remember. Thank you for the light.
ch05.objective.room4: Find out why the fire burns
ch05.objective.room5: Give your name to the scribe
ch10.toast.faithfulAhead: Look! Faithful is walking on the road ahead.
ch10.christian.proud: Ha! I am ahead of you, Faithful!
ch10.christian.oops: I was so proud of passing you, I forgot to look down.
ch10.faithful.pride: Pride trips the fastest feet. Let us walk side by side.
ch10.talkative.pile.1: Hello! A lovely day for talking!
ch10.talkative.pile.2: Did I tell you about my hat?
ch10.talkative.pile.3: I know every word in every book!
ch10.talkative.pile.5: Shall I keep going? I shall keep going!
ch10.christian.mayAsk: May I ask you something, Talkative?
ch10.choice.whatTalk: What do you like to talk about?
ch10.choice.doIt: Do you do the good things you talk about?
ch10.talkative.everything: Everything! Heaven, the weather, and my hat.
ch10.talkative.shiny: It is big and shiny, and I know all about it!
ch10.talkative.doThem: Do them? Talking about them is just as good!
ch10.faithful.lamp: Faith that only talks is like a lamp that never shines.
ch10.toast.stares: The crowd stares at your strange clothes.
ch10.keeper.call.sweets: Sweets! The sweetest in the land!
ch10.keeper.call.trinkets: Charms and bells! Buy, buy, buy!
ch10.keeper.games: Roll the ball and win a prize! Just one go?
ch10.keeper.sweets: Sticky buns and sugar mice! Fill your pockets!
ch10.keeper.hats: Every pilgrim needs a shiny hat. Try this one!
ch10.keeper.trinkets: Lucky charms and golden bells! Buy them all!
ch10.keeper.yes: Wonderful! I will pop it in a bag for you.
ch10.faithful.sigh: Oh, Christian... that bag will slow you down.
ch10.toast.bag: A bag of fair things. It feels heavy!
ch10.crier.noStall: The truth? There is no stall for that!
ch10.crier.guards: Guards! These two are spoiling the fair!
ch10.hategood.order: Order! These strangers have upset my whole fair!
ch10.envy.says: They say our fair is foolish. The cheek of it!
ch10.superstition.says: They would not even touch my lucky charms!
ch10.pickthank.says: My lord, they never once said you were wonderful.
ch10.hategood.speak: Prisoner! What do you say for yourself?
ch10.choice.king: We follow the King of the Celestial City.
ch10.choice.truth: We only wanted to buy the truth.
ch10.faithful.brave: Whatever happens, I will not stop loving the King.
ch10.hategood.verdict: The jury has decided. Back to the cage until morning!
ch10.jury.title: THE JURY
ch10.faithful.goodbye: The King has sent for me, Christian! I will see you there.
ch10.christian.goodbye: Goodbye, Faithful. You went to the King first.
ch10.toast.doorOpen: In the quiet night, the cage door swings open.
ch10.toast.caught: A watchman saw you! Back to the start.
ch10.objective.sneak: Sneak past the lanterns to the gate
ch10.toast.caughtHint: Caught! Wait until the light moves away, then hurry past.
ch10.toast.asleep: The watchmen have nodded off. Tiptoe past!
badge.firstPromise.name: First Promise
badge.firstPromise.line: You found your first glowing Promise.
badge.firstPromise.hint: Look for a glowing scroll near the Way.
badge.arrowDodger.name: Arrow Dodger
badge.arrowDodger.line: You reached the gate without one arrow bonk.
badge.arrowDodger.hint: Hide by the rocks and time your dash to the gate.
badge.wideAwake.name: Wide Awake
badge.wideAwake.line: You never sat down in the arbour.
badge.wideAwake.hint: Is a comfy bench always a good idea?
badge.unshaken.name: Unshaken
badge.unshaken.line: You beat Apollyon without losing a heart.
badge.unshaken.hint: Block every slam and dart, and keep all five hearts.
badge.brightLantern.name: Bright Lantern
badge.brightLantern.line: Your lantern never fell below half in the dark valley.
badge.brightLantern.hint: Keep walking and pray when the shadows come.
badge.prideTrip.name: Oops-a-daisy!
badge.prideTrip.line: You raced past Faithful and fell flat on your face.
badge.prideTrip.hint: What happens if you run past a friend?
badge.noThankYou.name: No, Thank You!
badge.noThankYou.line: You said no to every stall at Vanity Fair.
badge.noThankYou.hint: Look at the stalls... and say no to them all.
badge.unseen.name: Light Feet
badge.unseen.line: You slipped past every watchman's lantern.
badge.unseen.hint: Wait for the light to move, then tiptoe past.
badge.keyRemembered.name: I Remember!
badge.keyRemembered.line: You used the Key of Promise before anyone reminded you.
badge.keyRemembered.hint: What did you get at the Cross? Look in your Satchel.
badge.sharpEyes.name: Sharp Eyes
badge.sharpEyes.line: You did not follow the flattering guide.
badge.sharpEyes.hint: A true guide points up, not at you.
badge.goodCompany.name: Good Company
badge.goodCompany.line: You met twelve friends and strangers on the road.
badge.promiseKeeper.name: Promise Keeper
badge.promiseKeeper.hint: Every land hides glowing Promises. Find them all!
ui.satchel.badges.title: Badges
ui.toast.allPromisesHere: Every Promise in this land is found!
ui.loading.recap.title: Last land:
ch05.interpreter.room1Intro: A picture hides in the dark. Light the three lamps to see it.
ch05.interpreter.room2Intro: What a dusty room! Can you make it clean?
ch05.interpreter.room3Intro: Passion wants his toys now. Who will you sit beside?
ch05.interpreter.crumble: Oh dear. Look, his toys are crumbling away!
ch05.interpreter.room4Lesson: Someone pours oil in secret. That is how the King keeps your fire burning.
ch05.interpreter.room5Lesson: Brave hearts go in. The King knows every name.
ch05.interpreter.room6Intro: A sad man sits in an iron cage. Can you open it?
ch05.name.title: Your name, please
ch05.name.line: The scribe will write it on your Roll.
ch05.name.label: Your name
badge.patientHeart.name: Patient Heart
badge.patientHeart.hint: Some gifts are worth waiting for.
ch11.toast.asleep: Under the tree they rest... and fall fast asleep.
ch11.toast.carried: Hm! Giant Despair found them and carried them off!
ch12.toast.lostLambs: Five little lambs ran off! Can you bring them home to the fold?
ch12.toast.lambFound: A lamb! It follows you. ({n} of {total})
ch12.toast.flockHome: Every lamb is home! The shepherds cheer.
ch12.glass.hold: Your hands are wobbly! Hold still...
ch12.glass.seen: Look! The Celestial Gate, shining far away!
ch12.sleepy.label: Sleepy
ch12.toast.tooSleepy: So sleepy... Talk with Hopeful to stay awake!
badge.goodShepherd.name: Good Shepherd
badge.goodShepherd.line: You brought all five lambs home.
badge.goodShepherd.hint: Listen for little bleats in the mountains.
badge.farSight.name: Far Sight
badge.farSight.line: You saw the Celestial Gate through the looking glass.
badge.farSight.hint: Hold very still on a high hill.
ch12.glass.holdTouch: Wobbly hands! Hold your finger on the screen to keep it still.
